parts.text:
When a muscle cell is stimulated, calcium ions are released from the sarcoplasmic reticulum.

With reference to Fig. 1.1, describe the role of calcium ions in the contraction of the sarcomere.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
When a mammal dies, aerobic respiration stops. The striated muscles contract and remain contracted for a few hours after death.

Suggest why the muscles remain contracted for a few hours.
